summary.text: Larry Hutchinson is the Republican candidate for Michigan House of Representatives District 70 in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Democratic Rep. Cynthia Neeley.
He advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026, defeating Rob Waskoviak with 59.0% of the vote.
